subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Which open fix path should be canonical for this issue, and should real behavior proof be required before merging it?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but there are three open closing PRs with different retryability boundaries and proof states; choosing the canonical branch and any proof override is maintainer intent.

options.title: Use narrowed runtime guard with proof
options.body: Treat the narrowed timeout/429/5xx runtime guard as the preferred path and require redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Switch to gateway/UI recovery
options.body: Keep non-benign compaction failures terminal and instead restore Composer retry behavior in the gateway/UI lifecycle path.

options.title: Override proof for source-only fix
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept source and test proof only, but that leaves the reported Composer recovery path unproven in a real setup.

recommendation.title: Use narrowed runtime guard with proof
recommendation.body: Treat the narrowed timeout/429/5xx runtime guard as the preferred path and require redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the prior item-specific retryability guidance and is already mentioned in the issue discussion for this decision.
